verdict.rationale: Exposing a local vault endpoint for agents is a fair question for an authenticator/secrets app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a local programmatic surface for a user's own TOTP vault. The documented Authy API/SDK is a developer service for adding 2FA to third-party apps, and it is now closed to new customers. Community reports say getting at your own seeds requires hacky debug-mode extraction because no export or API exists.
